#MikeBrown didnt have to comply to police. 
He didnt have to be small & unassuming. 
He was still considered a threat tho he was unarmed. 
He deserved to still be here. He deserved to be black and big and free. And justice. #blacklivesmatter #4hrs #4yrslater

@moiragweigel @goldietaylor @Jo_Livingstone How can the #metoo movement be invalidated. 

Women are also predators and violators and enablers. I don’t doubt she was raped and simultaneously I don’t deny she raped/violated. SHE is the hypocrite, not the movement itself.

@Locus_of_Ctrl @moiragweigel @goldietaylor @Jo_Livingstone She’s a hypocrite because she didnt make amends *besides some money* when she victimized someone else. You still have to believe victims, but in her case particularly you step back. But that doesnt invalidate #metoo

All predators should catch fades.

@FalseCorn @Locus_of_Ctrl @moiragweigel @goldietaylor @Jo_Livingstone @FalseCorn leave me out of this. 

#metoo came from a real place. It’s a real problem speaking to misogyny and patriarchy. #TimesUp on all predators, male and female.

Men are now trying to pidgeon hole and negate the validity of #metoo and #timesup because a small handful of notable women are narcissists and are also sexual predators.  

I don’t want to engage in any more discourse with obtuse people about this.
